notes.title: ReLinked First Update!

tags.feature: - two new skills: molotov cocktail and sun spear;
- two new weapons: crossbow and automatic grenade launcher;

notes.title: Game changes and bug fixes

tags.balance_change: - Jerk is now directed towards the character's movement, rather than behind the mouse;

tags.feature: - Added camera shake when taking damage;

tags.balance_change: - The maximum attack enhancement level has been raised to level 15.

tags.bug: - Sword deals damage when time stops;

tags.balance_change: - Speed of spheres on Chinese location reduced;

tags.feature: - Added OK sign on the enhancement panel;

tags.balance_change: - Reduced the price of turret, triangle shield, weapon stations and healing. Turret health has been increased;
- Arrows became cheaper; Changed their interaction with shields, arrows are not destroyed on collision with them, but slowed down;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug when dragging weapons;

tags.feature: - Removed the Chinese warrior health image that was used for testing.

tags.balance_change: - energy now restores to maximum as you level up;

tags.bug: - fixed text display in weapon and skill panels;
- fixed the ghost bug that was crashing the game;
- fixed the health bar bug with going into minus;

notes.title: The game has been released. What's next?
notes.content:
[b]Hello, comrades![/b].

Thank you for your interest in the project and the feedback you've left. At the moment I plan to develop two updates to the game. Let's take a look at each of them. 

[b]1) New locations will be added for the survival mode.[/b]
- North Korea, a region with sakura trees. 
- Yugoslavia. Suburban region.

2) From them and the locations formed now will be [b]created story mode[/b], which will tell you about the world of the game, about the universe, about the alien attack, about the main character mysterious Vladlen Vernadsky, about psionics. It will have several endings.

In addition, new weapons will be added. new skills, new bosses, new enemies.

I can't give a definite release date, but I promise to realize it.

Thank you, friends!

notes.title: On the way to release
notes.content:
Good afternoon, comrades!As you know, we are developing a rogue-lite game with Action-RPG elements, today I want to answer some questions.
[h3]Title change[/h3]
You may have noticed the rebranding of the game, why did we do it?
1) The negative connotation of the word INFIDELITY. We took it to mean "Disbelief", but its main meaning is "Adultery", primarily marital, so it was decided to change the name of the game
2) Secondly this title is hard to remember, it doesn't stick in your memory;
3) Steam already has a game with the name Red Sunrise;

[h3]Development progress[/h3]

1. We have added all planned weapons to the game, both melee and ranged - these include different types of swords, axe, spear, bow, pistols, machine guns, rifles, grenade launcher, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988278/97120fd3bdb9d761872b7aa0b52f005da7b03d1f.png[/img]

2. Most skills have been completed - fireballs, invulnerability, teleportation, shields, setting up turrets and more are all in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43988278/4ac9be2cb386b6ad04028ee94c8a18e31dae4c05.png[/img]

3. Completed two locations - Soviet Union and China
4. Started translation into two languages - Russian and English, possibly Chinese will be added.

Now there is a finalization of some skills, algorithms spawn enemies and bosses, balance.

[h3]Release date?[/h3]
Autumn 2023.

That's all for now, thanks for being with us!
